snippet.title: Spear - Interview Default
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453000/Spear/

We tried to interview him about the bugs… but he couldn't answer.
👾 Meet DEFAULT, the main character of SPEAR — not much of a talker, but hey, words aren’t exactly his strongest suit.
➡️ SPEAR, our indie platform game, releases on 05.05.2025… and it’s guaranteed to leave you speechless (more than once).
